# op_item (Resource)

Manages a 1Password item.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Item category, e.g. `Login`, `Password`, `SecureNote`.
- `title` (String) Item title.
- `vault_id` (String) ID of the vault containing the item.

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Destroy behavior: `delete` permanently deletes the item, `archive` archives it instead.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Item fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `notes` (String) Item notes.
- `sections` (Attributes List) Item sections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
- `version` (Number) Item version.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `title` (String) Field label.

Optional:

- `section_id` (String) Section the field belongs to.
- `type` (String) Field type, e.g. `Text`, `Concealed`, `Totp`, `Url`.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field value. Treated as sensitive.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Field ID.


<a id="nestedatt--sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections`

Required:

- `title` (String) Section title.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Section ID.
